mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Users (user_type, username, password, register_time, user_status, is_active, phone, email) VALUES (#{userType}, #{username}, #{password}, #{registerTime}, #{userStatus}, #{isActive}, #{phone}, #{email})
mapper.update: UPDATE Users SET user_type = #{userType}, password = #{password}, username = #{username}, register_time = #{registerTime}, user_status = #{userStatus}, is_active = #{isActive}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id as id, user_type as userType, username as username, password as password, register_time as registerTime, user_status as userStatus, is_active as isActive, phone as phone, email as email FROM Users WHERE id = #{id}
